title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty term to the loss function. This penalty term is controlled by the regularization coefficient, lambda.

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: As lambda increases, the penalty for large weights in the model increases, which can lead to a simpler model with smaller weights.

title: Bias and Variance Trade-off
text: Increasing lambda typically increases bias but decreases variance. This is because the model becomes less flexible and more generalized.
